title: Backend dispatch table: sign/verify/decrypt must never be NULL
description: wp11_backend.h vtable documents that free_key_priv and derive may be NULL, but does not document whether sign/verify/decrypt can be NULL. A backend that sets sign=NULL causes a NULL dereference in the dispatch path. There is no compile-time or runtime assertion that required ops are populated. Fix: add a wp11_backend_validate() that asserts required function pointers on backend registration.
